name: kms
description: Everyday development skills for Claude Code: rigorously clarify a plan through interrogation, or turn one into durable knowledge artifacts and a standalone roadmap; bootstrap and steward a project's fact/decision/guardrail system across sessions, lint it for structural rot, and query it for answers with citations; attribute commits and PRs to their underlying intent, and generate changelogs from commit history.
